dct_title_s: Regni Hungariae et Regionum, quae ei quondam fuêre unitae, ut Transilvaniae, Valachiae, Moldaviae, Serviae, Romaniae, Bulgariae, Bessarabiae, Croatiae, Bosniae, Dalmatiae, Sclavoniae, Morlachiae, Ragusanae Reipublicae maximaeq partis Danubii Fluminis, novissima delineatio
dct_description_sm: 3 bar scales on map, given in “Milliaria Hungarica,” Milliaria Germanica,” and “Milliaria Gallica.”
Decorative cartouche with figures and cherubs, compass rose, latitudinal and longitudinal lines.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 111.
Tear disrupts imprint; information supplied by cataloger.
